title: Final Answers for N
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly identify the two possible values for the index of refraction N in terms of epsilon and g.

title: Final Answers for E0
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expressions for the polarization vectors E0 corresponding to each value of N.

title: Use of Maxwell's Equations
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate proper use of Maxwell's equations to derive the relationships needed for the solution.

title: Determinant Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly set up and solve the determinant condition to find the relationship between N, epsilon, and g.

title: Transverse Wave Condition
description: Important Criteria: The student should recognize and state that E_z = 0, confirming the transverse nature of the wave.

title: Sign and Factor Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors in signs or factors when manipulating equations, particularly in the determinant step.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all quantities are consistent in terms of units throughout the derivation.

title: Alternative Approaches
description: Optional Criteria: The student may provide alternative methods or reasoning to arrive at the same conclusions, enhancing the robustness of their solution.
